A defined scope

Know what we
are building together.

Requirements, deliverables, and acceptance criteria are agreed for your project. The items below are topics to define during discovery, rather than a fixed package.

  • Discovery questions, user tasks, and content needs
  • Wireframes and interaction flows
  • Visual interface design and reusable components
  • Responsive, keyboard, and accessibility considerations
  • Design review and implementation handoff

Common questions

Before we begin.

What is the difference between UI and UX?

UX considers how the overall experience supports user goals. UI focuses on the interface people interact with. A project usually benefits from considering both together.

Can design be delivered before development?

Yes. Discovery, wireframes, and visual designs can form a separate phase, with the development handoff agreed in the scope.

Can you audit a product without redesigning everything?

Yes. An audit can identify specific issues and prioritize improvements, allowing the team to address the most important problems first.
